g.text: Note: Parameters provided for AppProxyNeeds are examples. Actual ProxySpecs depend on the application's needs.
Note: GetProxyContainer() is not supported when all requested ProxySpecs are mandatory.
Note: Uses a local ActiveServiceDiscovery type inside Build().
Classes colored green are provided by
Mandatory path exposes no explicit stop API
Extract transfers ownership of stop control.
MultiInstanceHolder itself does not own stop logic.
